<div style="display: flex; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 1em;">
  <svg width="800" height="300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
    <defs>
      <marker id="arrowhead2" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="10" refY="3.5" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">
        <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" fill="#0046c4" />
      </marker>
    </defs>
    <!-- Text Rectangle -->
    <rect x="30" y="60" width="250" height="80" fill="#e3f2fd" stroke="#333" stroke-width="1.5" rx="12" />
    <text x="45" y="90" font-family="Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="bold">Text:</text>
    <text x="45" y="115" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">The dog barked and the cat purred.</text>
    <!-- Controlled Keywords Table -->
    <rect x="400" y="40" width="220" height="120" fill="#fff" stroke="#333" stroke-width="1.5" rx="8" />
    <text x="415" y="65" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">Controlled Vocabulary</text>
    <text x="420" y="95" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">Dog</text>
    <text x="420" y="120" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">Cat</text>
    <text x="420" y="145" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">Mouse</text>
    <!-- Arrows for matches -->
    <path d="M90,110 C150,70 350,70 420,90" stroke="#0046c4" stroke-width="3" fill="transparent" marker-end="url(#arrowhead2)" />
    <path d="M210,120 C300,130 370,120 420,115" stroke="#0046c4" stroke-width="3" fill="transparent" marker-end="url(#arrowhead2)" />
    <!-- Labels for arrows -->
    <text x="250" y="70" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#0046c4">"dog" → Dog</text>
    <text x="290" y="140" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#0046c4">"cat" → Cat</text>
  </svg>
</div>
